description: Answer a message sent with option or form, the same way a tap or a form submit does in the web app: pick an option (key or label), write your own answer (text), fill the form (fields) or decline it (skip). Shows as [chose ...], [own answer to ...], [form answer to ...] or [skipped form ...].

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

fields.description: Form answers by field key, e.g. {"name": "Ada", "size": "M"}; a choice field takes one of its options

message.description: Id (msg_...) of the message with options or a form

option.description: Key (o1, o2, ...) or label of the option to pick

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

skip.description: Decline a form instead of filling it

text.description: Your own answer instead of an option, up to 500 characters

name: huddo_answer
